description: Perform a verifiable random draw (commit-reveal + drand) of winners from contestants and prizes. Saves a proof page on rfwin.uk/d/:id. Free for all accounts (free tier: up to 10,000 contestants per draw; paid plans: larger draws). Optional radio preset: alternates (ordered backup winners), station, show. Optional visibility: "public" (default, indexable) or "private" (unlisted: works and verifies for anyone with the link, but noindex and never listed).

algorithm.description: Drawing algorithm: random (equal weight) or weighted. Default random.

alternates.description: Optional number of ordered backup winners (0-20) drawn after the main prizes, e.g. for radio giveaways. Requires uniqueWinners.

contestants.description: List of contestants (names, emails, or usernames)

prizes.description: List of prizes and quantities to draw for

quantity.description: Number of winners for this prize (default: 1)

show.description: Optional show or segment name shown on the proof page.

station.description: Optional station name / call sign shown on the proof page.

uniqueWinners.description: If true, a contestant can win at most one prize. Default true.

visibility.description: Optional. "public" (default): proof page is indexable by search engines. "private" (alias "unlisted"): proof page works and verifies for anyone with the link (get_draw / verify_draw too) but is noindex,nofollow and never listed.

name: draw_winners

manageToken.description: Organiser token for PATCH https://rfwin.uk/api/draws/{id}/visibility (header X-RFWIN-Manage-Token). Keep private.
